name: Honda K-Series PCV Adapter - 10AN
title: Honda K-Series PCV Adapter - 10AN
description:
The Honda K-Series PCV Adapter - 10AN is a premium high-performance component engineered for rigorous fluid and boost applications. Whether you’re a professional building a 6-second NHRA bracket car, a perfectionist designing the ultimate engine bay for a SEMA car, or an HPDE enthusiast looking to improve your oil temps, their products are designed for all flavors of motorsports.

ColorFittings products are carefully machined from 6061-T6 Billet Aluminum and finished with their proprietary polish and anodizing process.

AN to Metric adapter or union fittings allow you to connect two female fitting points together, one metric and one AN flare end side.

These Adapters make a perfect fit and seal to their AN Fittings, which are specifically designed for use with their e85 and race-fuel compatible Nylon Braided Hoses.

For a hassle-free installation process, the manufacturer strongly recommend using their Fitting Assembly Tools. Please use their Reference Video for proper installation procedures.

Technical Specifications:
• Construction: Precision CNC-machined in the USA. (6061-T6 Billet Aluminum for fittings)
